title: Pollet & Wilson 2010 JFE: average correlation and stock market returns
note: Average pairwise correlation of the 49 French industry portfolios' daily returns, computed each month. High average correlation predicts higher US500 returns next quarter. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only. Reopened again 2026-11-02 (owner: a journal paywall is not a reason to drop; try the free copies first, prompt step 4). Free routes to try: the authors' pages (Pollet: Illinois; Wilson: Wharton/Penn) and RePEc/IDEAS versions of the 2008 working paper; Li et al. 2020 Accounting Research Journal (industry-portfolio average correlation, 2-month lag) and the Griffith University thesis (research-repository.griffith.edu.au, item 667ec362) restate the definitions and are free. Our 2018+ split is the test. Earlier: full text behind ScienceDirect paywall, cannot be read in full (search 2026-11-02)

title: Brogaard & Detzel 2015 MS: EPU innovations and future US500 returns
note: Baker-Bloom-Davis EPU index (free, monthly). An EPU innovation predicts higher US500 returns over the next 2-3 months. EPU-gold was dropped as in-sample only; this is the equity test and must pass OOS after 2015. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only. Reopened again 2026-11-02 (owner: a journal paywall is not a reason to drop; try the free copies first, prompt step 4). Free routes to try: the SSRN working paper (2012) through a mirror or the authors' pages (Brogaard: Utah; Detzel: Denver), RePEc/IDEAS, Google Scholar 'All versions'. The abstract already gives the rule: Baker-Bloom-Davis EPU forecasts 3-month excess returns (+1 sd EPU = +1.5% over 3 months); EPU is free from policyuncertainty.com. GWZ 2024 is a general claim, not a test of this rule: own test on 2018+. Earlier: full text not readable free (journal paywall); no OOS evidence; GWZ 2024 says predictors obsolete
